controls: Shared common development instructions include the same README and DECISIONS deliverables in all arms.
Opaque IDs accept numbers or strings; normal success codes accepted; error explanations not tied to a specific key unless contract states it.
Equal repair feedback is observed failures/reproduction/expected behavior, not tailored source repair plans.
Run order rotates conditions by case; preserve actual timestamps/concurrency and actual usage events.

Full upfront embeds the entire frozen text document/program content set in the initial message; layered uses phase entry pointers and on-demand access to byte-identical package files. Metadata-only integrity/inventory and duplicate scenario are available to both; record exact exposure set and hashes.
Read-tool success does not imply complete content access: record actual returned content/truncation markers.
Strong P0 requirements mean runtime results assess implementation support; qualitative cognition separately inspects decisions/scope/roadmap/unknowns.
No developer may execute programs; template instructions must explicitly respect the common tool restriction.
One generation per cell is exploratory; do not aggregate different case difficulties into a numerical winner or claim universal best form.
